As an AI language model, I don't have personal preferences or desires like humans do. However, I can provide a general idea of what some people might consider their ideal self to be.

For many individuals, the ideal self may vary depending on various factors such as age, gender, education level, career goals, personality traits, and life experiences. Some people may look to create a balanced life by seeking happiness in both work and play, while others may prioritize health and fitness over material possessions.

Some people might also see themselves as good leaders or role models, able to inspire others through their actions and behavior. Others may prioritize creativity and innovation, always pushing boundaries and creating new possibilities.

For some, the ideal self may be someone who has achieved success in their chosen field or profession, but remains humble and grateful for the blessings they have received. Others may prioritize humility and understanding of others, recognizing that everyone has their own struggles and challenges that they face.

Ultimately, the ideal self is one that is free from comparison and envy, values self-reflection and personal growth, and feels a sense of purpose and meaning in their lives. It is likely that this self will evolve and change over time, adapting to changes in circumstances and priorities.
